model_meta.description: Conceptual model of a clamp fixing a work pallet or die to a base through steel balls engaging bush recesses, actuated by an axial output member.

subsystems.description: Ring-shaped bush fixed to the clamped object, with circumferential partial-sphere recesses for steel-ball engagement.
Base-mounted body with tubular section inserted through the bush, radial ball support locations, and an axle hole for the output member.
Plurality of radially movable steel balls engaging corresponding bush recesses; detailed embodiment specifies six.
Movable piston/output member whose axial motion and profile drive outward engagement or inward retreat of the balls.
Plural disc springs urge the output member axially toward clamping (claim 6).
Drives the output member axially against disc-spring force to release ball engagement (claim 7).
External work pallet or die carrying the bush.
External base body to which the clamped object is fixed.
External device connected through the base-member oil passage to supply and discharge hydraulic pressure to the cylinder oil chamber.

item_flows.name: Hydraulic pressure
item_flows.notes: Supplied to cylinder to drive release against spring force.

steps.description: Disc springs urge the output member axially toward the clamped position.
The output-member profile moves the balls radially outward.
The balls engage the bush recesses, fixing the object to the base.
Hydraulic force drives the output member axially against disc-spring force.
The output-member recess profile permits the balls to retreat radially inward.
Ball engagement is removed and the object is released from the base.
